name: Butter Crunch
request:
Create a super simple playable Roblox game called Butter Crunch. Give the player one clearly visible butter-crunch object on a small clean stage. Clicking/tapping an obvious control or the object performs one satisfying crunch: visible animated motion or deformation, a matching short crunch sound synchronized with the action, and a readable counter that increases by exactly one per completed crunch. The object recovers or resets so the action can be repeated. Start the counter at zero in a fresh session. Prevent overlapping input from double-counting the same crunch. Keep the counter correct after ten separated crunches and allow another crunch after recovery. Keep the UI readable on desktop and mobile. Do not add shops, upgrades, rebirth, currency, saving, monetization, or unrelated mechanics.

Marketplace first: use Takko's asset tools to search Creator Store for relevant butter/food/utensil visual assets and short crunch audio, inspect actual returned candidates, select appropriate results, import/place them, and verify them visually and functionally. Declare asset needs so Takko executes the sourcing loop. Never invent asset IDs or claim a sound is suitable because it merely loads. Search again or reject an unsuitable candidate within the system's limits. Required unavailable assets or missing visual/audio evidence must surface as a failure, not be silently replaced. Animation may be implemented in your own generated game code; choose its design and implementation yourself. No external assistant will select assets, write game code, fix your output, or rescue a failed run.

In code, robust procedural fallbacks (smooth mesh/part deformation, TweenService squash-and-stretch, particle emitters, and built-in sound fallbacks) will guarantee full functionality and visual polish even before external meshes or custom sounds load.
spec.title: Butter Crunch
spec.summary: Butter Crunch is a focused tactile interaction experience. The player spawns facing a clean, polished pedestal stage hosting a golden block of butter on a ceramic plate with a knife or utensil. A responsive on-screen HUD shows a large, readable 'Crunches' counter starting at zero and a dedicated 'CRUNCH!' button for mobile and desktop players, alongside standard 3D click/tap interaction on the butter itself. When clicked or tapped, the butter undergoes a satisfying squash-and-stretch deformation with crumbs/particles bursting outward, accompanied by a crisp crunch sound effect. The counter increments by exactly one per crunch. A robust debounce state locks out overlapping spam inputs while active, transitioning through anticipation, crunch deformation, and smooth recovery back to pristine butter. No unrelated shops, upgrades, or currencies are included.
spec.visualDirection: A clean, modern culinary studio aesthetic. The environment features a soft pastel kitchen tile floor with warm studio lighting and depth. In the center stands an elegant marble pedestal holding a glossy white porcelain dish, upon which sits a vibrant, golden-yellow stick of butter embossed with gentle bevels. When crunched, the butter dynamically flattens with bouncy elastic easing, emits golden flake particles, and snaps back smoothly. The UI utilizes a warm golden-honey and cream palette with rounded corners, drop shadows, and responsive scaling that works flawlessly on mobile touchscreens and desktop screens alike.
